'''''The Duelist''''' was Wizards of the Coast's trading-card-game magazine. It ran from a 1993 issue 0 through issue 41 in September 1999, from Renton, Washington.<ref name="wp-duel" /> It profiled Star Wars CCG alongside ''Star Trek'' and other licensed games.<ref name="wp-duel" />

[[Allen Varney]] reviewed Premiere as [[A Forced Effort (The Duelist)|A Forced Effort]] in issue 9 (February 1996).<ref name="duelist9" /> [[Lester Smith]] and [[Cory Herndon]] wrote later set features. Varney and Herndon also filed game-news columns that named SWCCG expansions.<ref name="wp-swccg" />

The dated catalog is [[Magazines]].
